profile_text.body:
DeepAI, operated by Deep AI, Inc., describes itself as an all-in-one creative AI platform built for general audiences. The company traces its origins to late 2016, when it launched what it describes as the first browser-based text-to-image generator. Since then it has expanded its platform to include image generation, photo editing, short video creation, original music composition, AI chat with internet browsing, and voice-based AI conversation, all accessible directly in a browser and through APIs.

Beyond its consumer-facing tools, DeepAI also takes on custom technical work for governments, nonprofits, and research organizations, including computer vision systems, perception and mapping pipelines, and other production-grade AI deployments. The company runs an initiative it calls "AI for Good," focused on environmental and conservation applications, and in 2025 became the major sponsor of Tuvalu's national futsal team. DEEPAI and the Dolphin Design are registered trademarks of Deep AI, Inc. in the United States and other territories.

The site's held facts confirm DeepAI has a tracked product listed under image generation, consistent with the platform's origins, and no litigation or MCP registry entries are on record.
